# Natives CLIProxyAPI fork

Source: `github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8` at tag
`v8.0.28` (MIT), commit `0d18d3b365be000eeaee7de4615f9da596b2059d`.
Synced from the upstream checkout by exporting `internal/`, `sdk/`, `go.mod`,
and `go.sum` via `git archive v8.0.28`.

Only `sdk/`, `internal/`, module metadata, embedded runtime assets, and the
license are retained. The upstream CLI, management UI, examples, and product
runtime are intentionally excluded.

Natives-specific changes on top of upstream (captured as replayable diffs in
`natives-patches/*.patch`; the in-app kernel updater re-applies them after
exporting an upstream tag — keep that directory in sync with any change):

- `sdk/cliproxy/usage/manager.go` (+ `manager_lifecycle_test.go`): the v8 usage
  dispatcher uses a `running` flag instead of `sync.Once` so it can restart
  after a gateway restart, and the queue is bounded — the `NewManager(buffer)`
  capacity is enforced, total queued payload is capped at 8 MiB, queued
  records no longer pin request contexts (dispatch uses a detached context so
  downstream disconnects cannot drop completed usage), oversized diagnostic
  failure bodies and response-header snapshots are trimmed without touching
  billing atoms, a full queue applies cancellable backpressure, `Stop` drains
  the queue and joins the dispatcher with a bounded 5s join, and `Publish`
  after `Stop` delivers synchronously to still-registered plugins instead of
  resurrecting the dispatcher. The patch retains v8's API-key provenance,
  access-provider, and native-key metadata before applying queue bounds.
- `internal/runtime/executor/antigravity_executor_credits.go` (+ test):
  antigravity 400 responses whose body contains "user location is not
  supported" are surfaced as retryable 503 errors instead of permanent
  failures.
- `sdk/cliproxy/static_models.go` (fork-added): bridge exposing
  `registry.GetStaticModelDefinitionsByChannel` to SDK consumers.
- `internal/runtime/executor/openai_compat_json_stream.go` and its executor caller: OpenAI streaming clients accept a provider that returns one JSON completion despite `stream=true`; convert it to SSE without retrying, retain usage and message fields, bound the payload and close the original response. Captured in `0002-json-stream-compatibility.patch`.
- `sdk/cliproxy/natives_version.go` (fork-added): compile-time SDK version;
  regenerated by the development updater so ordinary rebuilds and running
  binaries identify the code they actually contain.
- `internal/runtime/executor/helps/payload_mutations_test.go`:
  `TestConfigExampleDocumentsCodexAdditionalToolsPayloadFilter` is removed —
  it reads the upstream repo-root `config.example.yaml` which the trimmed
  layout excludes.

Upstream OAuth client credentials (e.g. antigravity `constants.go`) are
kept as-is from upstream; do not blank them — blanked client ids break
Google authorization with "Missing required parameter: client_id".

## In-app development updater

The existing update button calls `model_kernel_update`; it does not download
or run the standalone upstream CLI. Only repository `target/debug/model-host`
and `target/release/model-host` development binaries can be replaced. Installed
products use the complete, signed Natives update path.

Stable tags within the supported v8 major version are exported as gzip archives
into `.tmp/kernel-update/`, patched, tested with an isolated Go modfile, and
built before any live source or binary is replaced. Dependency metadata is
read-only: tags requiring dependency migration are rejected rather than
changing the host dependency graph. Failed builds leave the
current SDK intact. Directory replacement removes obsolete source files;
failed binary replacement restores the source, retaining recovery files if
restoration fails. The Native bridge keeps one Chrome input reader across
worker replacement. Loaded versions come from compiled code, not `version.txt`.

The adapter and replayable patches now target v8. A future tag with a different
major module path is still rejected with `kernel_migration_required` before any
download or source modification; it requires another reviewed SDK migration.
Reference: [upstream v8.0.28 release](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/releases/tag/v8.0.28)
and [module metadata](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/v8.0.28/go.mod).
